description_en: Hybrid media asset search. Combines the text search capability of DataQ - Smart Tag Service and the LLM-based search capability to perform multi-channel recall, allowing users to search using natural language descriptions
description_zh: 媒资混合搜索。智能标签文本搜索和大模型搜索能力合并进行多路召回，用户可以使用自然语言描述进行搜索
kebab_example: aliyun ice search-media-by-hybrid --search-lib-name test-1 --media-type video --page-no 1 --page-size 20 --text Two_pandas_are_fighting. --media-id 0000c469e944b5a856828dc20000 --namespace name-1 --custom-filters intField1_:_gte_:12,_lte_:13_,_strField2_:_cd_,_de_,_strField1_:_abc --utc-create gte_:1761205662998,_lte_:1771205662998 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SearchMediaByHybrid

Creation time, in milliseconds UNIX timestamp. gte means greater than or equal to, and lte means less than or equal to.

创建时间，毫秒时间戳。gte大于等于，lte小于等于。
